subject: fleet pooled-layer first-touch-prefill cut vs per-instance APC (pre-registered): the money-number is the mean cut + the sign result over distinct workloads. The betting-martingale e-value is disclosed but NOT headlined (it grows with the chosen block count on this deterministic accounting quantity).
honesty_tag: 🟡 MEASURED fleet — mean cut + sign result over distinct workloads; the e-value is a disclosed methodology artifact, not a p-value (retracts the earlier e-value headlines 357/12,285 as power-manufacturing by n)

metrics.workload_note: 29 distinct REAL conversation workloads from the Mooncake FAST'25 trace (committed fixture); 3 exact (apc_on,pooled) token-pair collisions dropped. The cut is a KV-reuse accounting quantity per real prompt; unlike the synthetic ramp, real blocks can have LITTLE OR NO reusable prefix (min cut can be 0), so the headline is the MEAN cut + the fraction clearing the floor — see money_number.caveat.

money_number.sign_result: 23/29 distinct workloads show a first-touch cut > the pre-registered floor 0.3
money_number.caveat: The first-touch cut is a NEAR-DETERMINISTIC token-accounting identity (cut = cached_tokens / apc_on_first_touch_prefill_tokens); the SIGN is guaranteed by KV reuse, so the claim is the DIRECTION + MAGNITUDE of the cut across distinct workloads, NOT a p-value or an e-value. The true uncertainty is cross-workload (does it hold on a BUYER'S traffic?), which no single-cluster run can settle.

evidence_note_NOT_a_pvalue.method: Waudby-Smith-Ramdas betting martingale (eprocess.py); pre-registered (m0/alpha/stopping fixed before the run) and optional-stopping-valid IN GENERAL.
evidence_note_NOT_a_pvalue.why_not_a_headline: Because the cut is a near-deterministic ratio (every block sits far above m0 by construction), each martingale factor is >1 and the e-value COMPOUNDS GEOMETRICALLY IN n. It therefore measures how many blocks we chose to run, not the strength of a stochastic effect — so we do NOT report it as 'e-value X rejects H0'. Prior sprints headlined this (357 at n=22, then 12,285 at n=36); that was power-manufacturing by n and is retracted here. The money-number is the mean cut + sign.

metrics.honesty: FLEET run over distinct-size workloads — the money-number is the mean cut + sign, not the e-value
